free_tier.stated: No recurring free tier. New accounts can earn up to EUR 15 in signup credit, EUR 5 each for product updates, following on X and joining the Discord community, granted once the email address is confirmed.
free_tier.notes: There is no perpetual monthly free allowance. Signup offers a one-time credit, not a recurring sandbox allowance.

per_object_cap.stated: workspace disk is 16 GB on GP-G2-2GB, 32 GB on GP-G2-4GB, 64 GB on GP-G2-8GB and 128 GB on GP-G2-16GB

retention.stated: A sandbox lives until the user deletes it. After 5 idle minutes it sleeps and only its workspace disk is billed; the next command or file call wakes it.

egress.terms: In the default isolated mode a sandbox reaches the internet over NAT and not the project's private network; overlay mode opts in to project databases and apps. Outbound traffic from applications and databases is not billed per GB: every instance includes 1 TB of outbound traffic per month as fair use, and object-storage and CDN egress are EUR 0.005 per GB.
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB of outbound traffic per month as fair use per instance
egress.price_per_tb: EUR 0.005 per GB for object storage and CDN egress

interface_detail: Create, run and delete sandboxes over the REST API, MCP, CLI or dashboard; the web terminal, files API, HTTPS previews and token-gated noVNC desktop supplement the API.
tooling: Hosted MCP server at mcp.nodion.com, nodion CLI, HTTP API at https://api.nodion.com with OpenAPI at /v2/openapi.yaml, and preinstalled coding CLIs in the Agents image.
chaining: Sandboxes join the same project, team and invoice as apps and databases; in overlay mode they reach project databases at <slug>.internal and apps at <app>.app.internal.

limits.value: Running time is billed per second and never costs more than the package's monthly price: GP-G2-2GB at EUR 0.0139/hour and EUR 10.00 per month of running time, GP-G2-4GB at EUR 0.0278/hour and EUR 20.00, GP-G2-8GB at EUR 0.0556/hour and EUR 40.00, GP-G2-16GB at EUR 0.1111/hour and EUR 80.00.
Commands run over the API take up to 15 minutes per call; key-authenticated API calls are rate limited per account with RateLimit headers and HTTP 429 plus Retry-After.

limits_note: A sleeping sandbox bills only its workspace disk, and deleting it stops billing. Personal API keys can be limited to sandbox read, write and exec.
binding_note: The package monthly running-time ceiling (EUR 10 for the smallest tier) is what a long-running workload reaches first; the 15-minute command cap is per call, not per sandbox.

identity_cost.detail: Signup offers Continue with GitHub or an email address with Start free; creating services needs an account balance above zero or a payment method, and the signup credit is granted after email confirmation. Card, SEPA direct debit or PayPal are the accepted payment methods.

reliability_note: Sandbox images base on Ubuntu 26.04; HTTPS previews and the browser desktop are available in isolated mode only, and overlay mode is needed to reach project databases.
confidence_note: Rates, idle sleep, egress, API and signup terms are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-24; no account or sandbox was created.
